blocking_findings.summary: Let task close remain the sole final-proof owner (docs/specs/delegation-boundary.md:79): When a caller invokes the documented `forge stage done` command directly, this section says it runs every required test and verify command; `_finish_stage()` confirms that it calls `run_stage_proof()` when close has not supplied proof.
blocking_findings.title: Let task close remain the sole final-proof owner

blocking_findings.summary: Route formal review through the close-owned proof path (factory/prompts/reviewer.md:4): When an orchestrator follows this prompt, line 4 directs it to release formal review with `./forge review <task-id>` and cites Decision 0054.
blocking_findings.title: Route formal review through the close-owned proof path

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the consumed non-native bootstrap writer (factory/scripts/factory_lib.py:4576): The supplied task record already contains the one-time bootstrap approval, and repository-wide call-site inspection finds this function referenced only by tests, so no production path reaches it after bootstrap.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the consumed non-native bootstrap writer

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the now-unreachable fixed-review reader (factory/scripts/forge_cli/findings.py:98): When any fixed review artifact exists, the new guard at line 78 always exits with upgrade guidance, so the loop at lines 98-103 can never read such an artifact.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the now-unreachable fixed-review reader

blocking_findings.summary: Require a fresh agent for each independent cold read (factory/scripts/forge_cli/grill.py:435): When a host-native griller task name is already live from an earlier pass or story, this guidance explicitly permits `followup_task`, which resumes the existing agent with its prior conversational context.
blocking_findings.title: Require a fresh agent for each independent cold read

blocking_findings.summary: Route task proof and review frontiers through `task close` (factory/scripts/forge_cli/phase.py:600): After a successful delegation lacks current proof, the `verify` frontier reaches this line and tells the coordinator to run the canonical verifier directly; the adjacent `tests` and `review` branches likewise prescribe separate commands.
blocking_findings.title: Route task proof and review frontiers through `task close`

blocking_findings.summary: Refuse required selectors whose JUnit identity is missing or ambiguous (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:2848): When the canonical JUnit report cannot prove exactly one declared node, the fallback selector may exit 0 while its report lacks the declared ID/path; `_run_required_tests` returns that condition in `test_id_misses`, but this line still stores the tests receipt as passed.
blocking_findings.title: Refuse required selectors whose JUnit identity is missing or ambiguous

blocking_findings.summary: Required-test commands can be skipped by an unrelated canonical test run (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:2243): Trigger: the canonical verifier emits a passing JUnit case with the same test ID and path as a required test whose declared command or environment differs.
blocking_findings.title: Required-test commands can be skipped by an unrelated canonical test run

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the compatibility-only return-shape branch (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:2829): Trigger: an older test double returns the legacy list shape instead of the production `(misses, results)` tuple.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the compatibility-only return-shape branch

blocking_findings.summary: Resume the supplemental migration manifest (factory/scripts/forge_cli/upgrade.py:3128): When a supplemental Lean migration is interrupted after publishing its incomplete manifest, the checkout is intentionally dirty, but this resume gate inspects only `lean-workflow-v2.json`.
blocking_findings.title: Resume the supplemental migration manifest

blocking_findings.summary: Validate shipped task proof from the fetched trunk (factory/scripts/pr_ready.py:104): When per-task PRs have been merged to `origin/main` while the coordinator's story worktree remains on its older branch, `require_closeout_order` confirms the markers on the fetched trunk, but this call supplies neither a trunk-pinned reader nor `inspected_head`.
blocking_findings.title: Validate shipped task proof from the fetched trunk

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the unreachable graph-amendment branch (factory/scripts/record_decomposition_from_json.py:529): On every re-record with prior tasks, a changed graph exits through the preceding exception while an unchanged graph reaches this unconditional `False`, so the later `if graph_amended` plan-withdrawal/reapproval branch can never execute.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the unreachable graph-amendment branch

blocking_findings.summary: Enforce the three-profile recovery target instead of the full registry (factory/tests/test_gates.py:20929): When init or upgrade is tested against the current source registry, this assertion requires every source agent file to remain configured and installed.
blocking_findings.title: Enforce the three-profile recovery target instead of the full registry

blocking_findings.summary: Keep the three-profile acceptance selector truthful (factory/tests/test_native_setup.py:462): When the required `test_recovery_profile_override_keeps_only_three_forge_profiles` selector runs, this replacement assertion requires sixteen configured and installed profiles rather than three.
blocking_findings.title: Keep the three-profile acceptance selector truthful

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the renamed model-policy test wrapper (factory/tests/test_native_setup.py:440): During normal pytest collection, this retained test calls the newly named test directly, so the same assertions execute twice.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the renamed model-policy test wrapper

blocking_findings.summary: Remove the renamed profile test wrapper (factory/tests/test_native_setup.py:479): When pytest collects this module, this compatibility test invokes the complete-registry test as a second test case.
blocking_findings.title: Remove the renamed profile test wrapper

blocking_findings.summary: Preserve accepted pre-Lean grounding for unchanged in-flight tasks (factory/tests/test_regrill_scope.py:230): When an in-flight task carries the pre-Lean in-stage grounding digest and its substantive contract is unchanged, this regression now requires `grounding_matches` to reject that record.
blocking_findings.title: Preserve accepted pre-Lean grounding for unchanged in-flight tasks

non_blocking_findings.summary: Rerun task close after recording functional proof (WORKFLOW.md:687): When a user-facing task reaches its first close without functional evidence, close stops before finishing the stage; after the functional checker runs, line 687 sends the operator directly to `task pr-ready` instead of rerunning close.
non_blocking_findings.title: Rerun task close after recording functional proof

non_blocking_findings.summary: Describe reviewed-meaning invalidation in the stamp contract (WORKFLOW.md:511): When task semantics, automated evidence, review instructions, or another reviewed-meaning input changes without changing product bytes, line 511 says the review stamp binds only to `delta_id` and remains valid.
non_blocking_findings.title: Describe reviewed-meaning invalidation in the stamp contract

non_blocking_findings.summary: Replace the remaining singleton artifact paths (WORKFLOW.md:8): For a scoped story, line 8 still presents `.factory/decomposition.json` as the current repository state location; the same document also names `.factory/grills/tasks/<id>.json` at lines 89 and 318, while its updated artifact sections use `.factory/stories/<key>/...`.
non_blocking_findings.title: Replace the remaining singleton artifact paths

non_blocking_findings.summary: Ship the Decision 0080 record referenced by the operating contract (docs/FACTORY.md:70): When a maintainer follows the role-routing authority cited here, there is no `docs/decisions/0080-*` record in the shipped tree; the decision directory ends at `0079-a-task-proof-runs-once-per-tree.md`.
non_blocking_findings.title: Ship the Decision 0080 record referenced by the operating contract

non_blocking_findings.summary: Describe native Stop as advisory (docs/FACTORY.md:24): When a native Codex coordinator stops with an incomplete active stage, this line promises that the Stop hook enforces continuation.
non_blocking_findings.title: Describe native Stop as advisory

non_blocking_findings.summary: Document the empty-manifest supplement exception (docs/architecture/dual-coordinator-parity.md:98): When a validated original Lean migration completed with no eligible rows and later merged history introduces eligible proof, this line categorically says an unequal partial retry refuses.
non_blocking_findings.title: Document the empty-manifest supplement exception

non_blocking_findings.summary: Retain the between-task coordinator transfer boundary (docs/architecture/dual-coordinator-parity.md:10): When a developer changes coordinators while a task is active, this replacement no longer states that transfer is allowed only between completed tasks and explicitly disclaims restrictions on stale resumption and concurrency.
non_blocking_findings.title: Retain the between-task coordinator transfer boundary

non_blocking_findings.summary: Do not describe quickfix as write authorization (docs/getting-started.md:47): When a user follows the blessed path without an approved task scope, this line presents `forge quickfix start` as an exception that permits product edits.
non_blocking_findings.title: Do not describe quickfix as write authorization

non_blocking_findings.summary: Route the detailed review step through task close (docs/getting-started.md:321): After the preceding manual test/verify commands, the detailed blessed path tells users to invoke `forge review` directly.
non_blocking_findings.title: Route the detailed review step through task close

non_blocking_findings.summary: Keep final verification out of the worker flow (docs/product/BRIEF.md:54): When a developer follows this key flow, the worker is told to run “deterministic verification” before the review loop.
non_blocking_findings.title: Keep final verification out of the worker flow

non_blocking_findings.summary: Document the authorized empty-manifest supplement path (docs/specs/dual-coordinator-parity.md:122): When a validated original migration manifest recorded an empty completion and later merged history introduces newly eligible proof, this paragraph says unequal retry refuses and provides no route to publish the supplement.
non_blocking_findings.title: Document the authorized empty-manifest supplement path

non_blocking_findings.summary: Limit native Plan Mode approval to plan and task gates (factory/prompts/griller.md:66): When the selected gate is `spec`, `signoff`, or `epics`, the generic continuation reaches this instruction and tells the coordinator to present a story or task plan through Plan Mode.
non_blocking_findings.title: Limit native Plan Mode approval to plan and task gates

non_blocking_findings.summary: Include host-native result identity in the recorder command (factory/prompts/griller.md:158): When the coordinator runtime is Codex, `forge grill run` records only a host-native prepared row, and `record_grill_from_json.py` admits the returned JSON only when passed both `--cold-result` and `--preparation-id`.
non_blocking_findings.title: Include host-native result identity in the recorder command

non_blocking_findings.summary: Allow findings to be dispositioned without changing the artifact (factory/prompts/griller.md:58): When a cold-reader finding is disproved by repository facts or resolved by an already accepted decision, this instruction still mandates editing the artifact merely because a finding exists.
non_blocking_findings.title: Allow findings to be dispositioned without changing the artifact

non_blocking_findings.summary: Treat malformed predecessor events as invalid instead of crashing (factory/scripts/factory_lib.py:3576): When an approval has a predecessor and any JSON file in its approval-events directory is malformed or interrupted, this unguarded `load_json` raises `JSONDecodeError` while scanning candidates.
non_blocking_findings.title: Treat malformed predecessor events as invalid instead of crashing

non_blocking_findings.summary: Fail closed on malformed story approval events (factory/scripts/factory_lib.py:3576): When an approved story plan has a `previous_approved_plan_sha256` and any `approval-events/*.json` entry is truncated or invalid JSON, this unguarded `load_json` raises instead of treating the ancestry as unauthenticated.
non_blocking_findings.title: Fail closed on malformed story approval events

non_blocking_findings.summary: Reject non-object task approval events before field access (factory/scripts/factory_lib.py:4456): When a task approval has predecessor history and any approval-event file contains valid non-object JSON such as `[]` or `null`, `load_json` returns that value and this `.get` raises `AttributeError`.
non_blocking_findings.title: Reject non-object task approval events before field access

non_blocking_findings.summary: Remove the unapproved context-file option from delegate (factory/scripts/forge.py:641): When a caller runs `forge delegate T1 --context-file PATH`, this newly registered option accepts supplemental file content for ordinary, including write-enabled, delegations.
non_blocking_findings.title: Remove the unapproved context-file option from delegate

non_blocking_findings.summary: Preserve the plan's existing newline bytes during approval (factory/scripts/forge_cli/approval.py:337): When a story plan contains CRLF or mixed line endings, `read_text()` normalizes them and this `write_text()` call rewrites the entire file using the host's newline convention, rather than changing only the managed frontmatter status.
non_blocking_findings.title: Preserve the plan's existing newline bytes during approval

non_blocking_findings.summary: Preserve completion order when selecting the latest reviewed task (factory/scripts/forge_cli/audit.py:136): When a shipped story has findings for multiple tasks whose identifiers are not lexically ordered by completion—as in the current decomposition—the sort uses the task string as the intra-story ordering key.
non_blocking_findings.title: Preserve completion order when selecting the latest reviewed task

non_blocking_findings.summary: Read live review proof for reopened tasks (factory/scripts/forge_cli/board.py:102): When an active/reopened task still has its prior `pr-ready.json` marker and publishes a fresh selected review, this call unconditionally supplies the old marker commit to `read_selected_review_generation`, so the board reads the historical sealed generation instead of the live selection.
non_blocking_findings.title: Read live review proof for reopened tasks

non_blocking_findings.summary: Resolve native context paths consistently with the validated source (factory/scripts/forge_cli/delegate.py:1975): With `--repo /other/repo --context-file relative.md` invoked outside that repository, `secure_context_snapshot(Path(args.context_file))` validates the file relative to the caller's current directory, but this line later rebases the same spelling under `base`.
non_blocking_findings.title: Resolve native context paths consistently with the validated source

non_blocking_findings.summary: Keep host-native task names collision-free (factory/scripts/forge_cli/delegate.py:1958): For task IDs that differ only by case or punctuation, such as `T-1`, `T.1`, and `T_1`, this normalization produces the same `task_name` (`t_1`).
non_blocking_findings.title: Keep host-native task names collision-free
